text:
sanjay: posting follow-up from this morning's postmortem: vendor signer throttling caused token refresh cascades and led to partial model-pull failures across multiple regions. putting concrete owners and dates here so we don't lose momentum.

ops-bot: Incident created: 2026-459 by sanjay — vendor auth throttling -> degraded model pulls.

elaine: We need fast mitigations + medium-term hardening. list items please.

ken: I'll take the client-side mitigations: jittered refresh + in-process token cache + exponential backoff with capped attempts. Working via feature flag. ETA 4d.

ash: I'll handle routing safeguards: per-region spill policy + failover weight ramping and a simple health-gating rule to stop spill if downstream error rate increases. ETA 6d.

maria: I'll add an e2e synthetic and update dashboards to show token-refresh success rate and first-byte latencies. Wire alerts to eng-oncall after 2 consecutive failures. ETA 3d.

tim: Vendor liaison — scheduling RCA call and requesting signer telemetry + rate-limit docs. will push for clearer 429 semantics and an elevated burst window for critical pulls. Target vendor call Fri 1500 UTC.

rachel: I'll prepare an SLA amendment draft that includes signer availability and incident notification windows. ETA Wed EOD for internal review.

acme-sre: We can join Fri 1500 UTC. We'll share signer logs and an initial mitigation plan; we suspect a config regress in our signer autoscaler during a surge.

sanjay: Action list from the doc:
- A1: Implement client jitter + capped retries for token fetch (owner: ken) — DUE +4d
- A2: In-process LRU token cache with short TTL & opt-in flag (owner: ken) — DUE +4d
- A3: E2E synthetic (token renew -> model pull -> smoke check) + dashboard + pager (owner: maria) — DUE +3d
- A4: Region spillover policy + gating + rollback playbook (owner: ash) — DUE +6d
- A5: SLA addendum draft & vendor RCA meeting prep (owner: rachel) — DUE Wed EOD
- A6: Harmonize client rate-limits with vendor guidance & add client-side throttling (owner: tim) — DUE +5d
- A7: Add weekly recurrence slot in postmortem tracker to spot regressions (owner: sanjay) — DUE +2d

elaine: I'll also add a routing circuit-breaker to prevent hot partitions from amplifying failures. low-risk rollout first. owner: elaine, due +7d.

ken: quick pseudo for cache behavior I plan to PR:
```
if (token_ttl < jitter_threshold) {
  refresh_with_backoff()
} else {
  use_cached_token()
}
```
PRs forthcoming.

maria: synthetic will include simulated 429s from signer to validate fallback and to ensure alarms are actionable. will add runbook steps for eng-oncall.

tim: vendor call agenda: share our spike logs, ask for signer quota tables, confirm 429 backoff semantics, and agree on notification SLAs.

ops-bot: Tagging: vendor:acme, subsystem:model-registry, impact:regional-degradation.

sanjay: Checkpoints: Wed internal SLA draft review, Thu engineering sync, Fri vendor RCA, next Tue final review. If any owners need to reassign, ping me.

acme-sre: We'll provide signer telemetry and an initial action list before the Fri call. Thanks for coordinating.

ken: opened PRs: backoff-helpers #4310, token-cache #4311 — requesting reviews from @maria @ash.

maria: reviewed token-cache, left minor comments. synthetic dashboard wired to ops and pager links added.

rachel: SLA draft up for review in the doc; legal looped in.

elaine: starting circuit-breaker change; feature-flagged rollout to staging today.

sanjay: Recording owners in the mitigation tracker and adding a monthly recurrence check for vendor-related auth incidents. Will update progress in the tracker daily. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
